sentences.text: 3 Crime No 488 of 2021 was registered against the appellants on 20 November 2021 at Police Station Paarva, District Yavatmal for offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code 18601 read with Sections 26 (2) (i), 27(2)(e), 30(2)(a) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

sentences.text: 1 7 Bail has been granted to Accused Nos 3 and 4 in pursuance of an order dated 10 December 2021 of the Sessions Court at Yavatmal in Criminal Bail Application No 415 of 2021.

8 Counsel for the appellants has drawn the attention of the Court to the contents of paragraph 4 of the counter affidavit filed by the State before the High Court, in which it has been clarified that:
4. The present applicant No. 1 was driving the vehicle and the applicant No.2 was seating in the piloting vehicle i.e. Tata Sumo.
Thus, both the applicants were patrolling to transporting vehicle i.e. Bolero, which contained contraband articles by concealing it in vegetables carets.

9 In the facts and circumstances, we order and direct that the appellants shall be released on bail,
subject to such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the Trial Court in connection with Crime No 488 of 2021.
10 The appeal is accordingly disposed of.
11 Pending application, if any, stands disposed of.
